intent: A code block for a webhook signature: filename tabs, line numbers, two highlighted lines, a diff of the same file, and a copy button that becomes a check without changing width.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colours as CSS variables on the root (--cb-surface, --cb-well, --cb-ink, --cb-muted, --cb-faint, --cb-line, --cb-line-strong, --cb-ok, --cb-err, --cb-accent)
stack.animation: motion/react: variants for the entrance, layoutId for the tab rule, AnimatePresence for the file swap and the copy check
stack.icons: one inline check mark; no icon package
stack.fonts: font-mono (Geist Mono) for filenames, line numbers and code; font-sans (Geist) for Diff and Copy

layout.root: section, @container, max-width 920px, 20px radius, overflow hidden, padding 20px and 24px from @xl
layout.chrome: filename tabs on the left with a hairline under them; Diff and Copy on the right, wrapping below the tabs when the row is narrow
layout.code: a well, 14px radius; lines wrap inside the card; line number, an optional diff mark, then the line
layout.highlight: a 2px accent edge and an 8% accent wash on two lines, not a solid bar
layout.diff: a plus or minus in the gutter and a 9% wash, ok for additions and err for removals

color.accent: #7cc4ff by default; the tab rule, the highlight edge, function names and numbers
color.syntax: keywords and punctuation are muted, comments are faint, strings and plain identifiers are ink. No second hue.

motion.entrance: the chrome and the code rise 10px out of a 6px blur, 60ms apart, 560ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.tab: the underline travels with layoutId on a spring, stiffness 500, damping 40
motion.swap: the file fades and rises 4px over 220ms
motion.copy: the label fades and the check scales in over 180ms, inside the same 4.75rem button, then returns after 1.6s
motion.reducedMotion: opacity only, 150ms or less; no blur, rise or spring

responsive.container: tabs and buttons are 44px tall below @lg and 32–36px from @lg
responsive.code: long lines wrap inside the well; the card does not widen the page
responsive.overflow: a wrapped line keeps its number on the first row

accessibility: The filenames are a tablist of tabs with aria-selected
Diff is a toggle with aria-pressed
The check exposes the accessible name Copied
The code region is named with the filename, or the filename plus diff
Keyboard-only 2px ink focus rings; tabs and buttons are 44px tall below @lg

content.files: verify.ts checks a ledgerline webhook signature; handler.ts calls it from a POST route
content.highlight: the five-minute window and the timing-safe compare
content.diff: the old code compared a hex digest to the header and read the secret from the environment; the new code takes the secret as an argument and rejects a stale timestamp

avoid: a solid highlight behind a whole line
letting the copy button change width when the check appears
